lines.en: Rin doesn't know I have her number yet, so I probably shouldn't call her...
lines.zh: Rin 还不知道我有她的号码，所以我大概不该打给她……

lines.en: I tap on Rin's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Rin 的名字，等她接电话。
她没有。

lines.en: I tap on Rin's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Rin 的名字，等她接电话。
她没有。

lines.en: I tap on Rin's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Rin 的名字，等她接电话。

lines.en: There's no answer. I guess she's busy right now.
lines.zh: 没人接。看来她现在在忙。

lines.en: I tap on Rin's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Rin 的名字，等她接电话。
: 致意并问候您，Sensei！
: 怎么啦？

lines.en: : Hey, what are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你现在在干什么？
: 悲伤女孩的事。

lines.en: : And what does that entail, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那具体包括些什么？

lines.en: : Coffee and loud music about girls.
lines.zh: : 咖啡，还有关于女孩的吵闹音乐。
: 你还在上班吗？

lines.en: : Would I have answered the phone if I was?
lines.zh: : 我要是在上班，还会接电话吗？
: 大概吧。

lines.en: : Dude! I am a GOOD employee. I follow the rules!
lines.zh: : 老兄！我可是个优秀的员工。我是守规矩的！

lines.en: : Unless the rule is making what the customer actually orders.
lines.zh: : 除非规矩是「照顾客真正点的东西做」。

lines.en: : I've already told you! You're special.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说过了！你是特别的。

lines.en: : So special that I'm giving you a once in a lifetime opportunity to come hang out and be a sad girl with me.
lines.zh: : 特别到我要给你一个一生只有一次的机会，过来陪我当个悲伤女孩。

lines.en: : I don't want to be a sad girl.
lines.zh: : 我不想当悲伤女孩。
: {i}坐标已经在路上了。{/i}
: {i}一路顺风，Sensei……{/i}
: Rin-

lines.en: The call comes to an end and I receive a text with an address shortly after.
lines.zh: 电话挂断，很快我就收到一条写着地址的短信。

lines.en: It turns out that the address I was sent was actually the address to another cafe in the area.
lines.zh: 结果那个地址是附近另一家咖啡馆。

lines.en: I'm not exactly sure what would compel someone who works at a cafe to spend their free time at a {i}second{/i} cafe, but I guess that's how things are going to be today.
lines.zh: 我不太明白，一个在咖啡馆工作的人，为什么会甘愿把空闲时间花在{i}第二家{/i}咖啡馆上，不过今天大概就是这样的一天。

lines.en: Rin orders some drink I immediately forget the name of as well as a few pastries and the two of us find a place to sit at a table near the window.
lines.zh: Rin 点了杯我转头就忘了名字的饮料，还有几样点心，我俩在窗边的桌子坐下。

lines.en: Despite being a self-proclaimed {i}sad girl{/i}, she seems pretty fine today.
lines.zh: 虽然她自称{i}悲伤女孩{/i}，今天看起来倒挺正常的。

lines.en: I don't know if that's just a thing [young]people are saying now, but I also acknowledge the fact that true despair can strike at any moment.
lines.zh: 我不知道这是不是现在[年轻]人流行的说法，但我也清楚，真正的绝望随时都可能袭来。

lines.en: And, more often than not, it's lurking somewhere in the background- waiting to devour people like her whole.
lines.zh: 而且它多半就潜伏在某个背景里——等着把她这样的人整个吞掉。

lines.en: No one is devoured and we have a good time.
lines.zh: 没有人被吞掉，我们玩得挺开心。
$ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}
